verified_key_information_units.information: Headline financial performance: Revenue increased 40% to DKK 126.5m (2024: DKK 90.1m), EBITDA grew 26% to DKK 31.1m (2024: DKK 24.7m), and Profit Before Tax (EBT) surged 109% to DKK 19.0m (2024: DKK 9.1m), driven by scaling of core titles and ad revenue optimization.

candidate_sentences.text: Total group revenue and other operating income increased by 40% to DKK 126,523 thousand, up from DKK 90,070 thousand in 2024.
Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization grew by 26% to DKK 31,117 thousand compared to DKK 24,671 thousand in the previous year, resulting in an EBITDA margin of 25%.
Profit before tax reached DKK 19,013 thousand, representing a 109% increase over the DKK 9,068 thousand reported in 2024, yielding an improved EBT margin of 15%.

verified_key_information_units.information: The 'Big 3' titles—Airline Manager, Truck Manager, and Farm Manager—collectively generated 67% of 2025 revenue (DKK 85m) and 65% of EBITDA, driven by Truck Manager's foundational scaling (revenue growth from DKK 1.2m in 2024 to DKK 25.2m in 2025) and Farm Manager's successful July 2025 launch with 5 million pre-registrations.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Progress & Results section (pages 13-20); Game Breakdown table (page 13); Truck Manager section (page 17); Farm Manager section (page 18)

candidate_sentences.text: The financial performance was heavily influenced by the strong commercial execution and scaling of core titles within the Transport Series, specifically Airline Manager, Truck Manager, and Farm Manager.
Airline Manager contributed revenue of DKK 37,787 thousand, reflecting a 28% increase.
Truck Manager experienced substantial growth following foundational improvements, with revenue surging by 1,971% to DKK 25,181 thousand.
Farm Manager, successfully launched in July 2025 following five million pre-registrations, generated DKK 22,002 thousand during its first six months.
Together, these three flagship titles formed the Big 3, generating 67% of total 2025 revenue and 65% of EBITDA.

verified_key_information_units.information: Strategic ad revenue optimization initiated in late September 2025 boosted In-App Ads (IAA) revenue by 100% to DKK 18.5m, improving monetization efficiency by eliminating platform fees and increasing IAA's share of total revenue to 14.6% (2024: 10.2%).
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Strategic Ad Revenue Optimisation section (pages 21-22); Financial Performance section (page 26)

candidate_sentences.text: A pivotal strategic development in late 2025 was the optimisation of in-app advertising across the portfolio.
Total in-app advertising revenue doubled to DKK 18,476 thousand, representing 14.6% of total revenue.

verified_key_information_units.information: 2026 financial guidance targets revenue of DKK 130-153m (+3% to +21%) and EBITDA of DKK 28-36m, with strategic focus on optimizing the existing portfolio, disciplined investment in Train Manager 2 and Space Manager, and maintaining margin discipline amid regulatory uncertainty.

candidate_sentences.text: The company looks ahead to 2026 with revenue guidance projected between DKK 130 million and DKK 153 million, EBITDA expected between DKK 28 million and DKK 36 million, and EBT expected between DKK 18 million and DKK 24 million.

verified_key_information_units.information: Strong liquidity position with a 78% solvency ratio (2024: 86%), total equity of DKK 66.1m, and completion of a DKK 5m share buy-back program, reflecting a robust capital structure with no interest-bearing debt.

candidate_sentences.text: The balance sheet remained robust with total assets growing by 24% to DKK 84,597 thousand, supported by a strong solvency ratio of 78% and an absence of interest-bearing external debt.
Total equity increased to DKK 66,120 thousand, delivering a return on equity of 20%.

Cash at bank and in hand ended the year at DKK 23,049 thousand, down 9% due to record marketing investments, a DKK 4,894 thousand share buy-back program, a temporary increase in other receivables including a DKK 14 million VAT receivable, and an extraordinary DKK 4.7 million repayment of historical tax credits following a reassessment by Danish tax authorities regarding game development R&D classifications.

verified_key_information_units.information: Framework-driven development strategy enables cost-efficient title launches, portfolio-wide upgrades, and a competitive moat, as evidenced by reusable codebases and retrofitting features like staff management and stock markets across titles.

details.completeness_justification: K1–K5 are fully represented with the headline financials, Big 3 performance, ad-revenue optimisation, 2026 guidance and liquidity metrics all captured. K6 on the framework-driven development strategy and reusable-codebase moat is entirely absent.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. Each sentence builds logically on the previous ones: revenue and profit growth are stated first, followed by the specific drivers (Big 3 titles), then the offsetting decline in smaller titles, the advertising shift, cost movements, and finally the balance-sheet and cash-flow effects. All numerical relationships are internally consistent within the text, and no sentence contradicts another. The narrative flows chronologically and thematically without repetition or structural gaps.
